description: Trap paths by hand (spread traps): give each filled path an overprinting stroke in its own fill colour, so the colour spreads into the inks around it by half the stroke weight. Paths with gradient, pattern or no fill are skipped

round.description: Round caps and joins. Default true

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

weight.description: Stroke weight in points; the trap is half of it. Default 0.5

name: make_trap_stroke
title: Make Trap Stroke
